species.atlasName: NIH Marmoset Atlas v1.1 merged label-workbook catalog
species.sourceSummary: Merged NIH Marmoset Atlas v1.1 label-workbook catalog across five parcellation blocks.
catalogNotes: For marmoset, group means parcellation block, not anatomical hierarchy.
The vL, vM, and vH volume sources are NIfTI members inside NIH_Marmoset_Atlas_V1_master.zip.

licenseCaveat: NIH Marmoset Atlas v1.1 materials are described for this staged handoff as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; preserve attribution, non-commercial/share-alike constraints, and verify current source terms before redistribution.

meshNamingConvention.description: Derived volume meshes must use regions[].meshName as the STL/OBJ stem before Blender packing. This JSON disambiguates duplicated CSV names with a group prefix when needed.

groupNormalization.description: Blank source CSV groups are normalized to frontend group Ungrouped. Source group text is preserved in sourceGroup.

duplicateLabelPolicy: Duplicate biological labels from source atlases are preserved. Use structureId or meshName, not label alone, as region identity.
